source.edition: NRL.com match centre, the 2000 NRL premiership
source.label: Computed from NRL.com match stats

conversion.formula: No game rated the 2000 season: each overall is computed from NRL.com's match centre, the season's premiership games, regular season and finals. Players: everyone NRL.com lists taking the field (a player named off the field only with minutes or a counted stat); his club is the one he played most games for (of two as many, the last). Position: the one he started at most in the season by its team lists, whatever his jersey; else most in the seasons either side, then two either side; else the first of his positions on the Rugby League Project; else he is left out. Value: his core points a club game, NRL Fantasy's points for eleven stats (`core`: 8 a try, 5 a try assist, 4 a line break, 2 a line-break assist, 1 a tackle, -2 a missed tackle, 2 a tackle break, 4 an offload, -2 an error (where NRL.com records no errors for a game, as for every game of 2013-2015, a handling error), 1 every 10 metres run and 1 every 30 kicked; goals and field goals not counted), the season's in full and the season before's at half weight when he played in it, over his club's games in each. NRL.com recorded eight of the eleven in 2000 (`stats`: tries, try assists, line breaks, tackles, missed tackles, offloads, errors and run metres), and only they count. Overall: the value's mid-rank percentile among the season's players at his position (ties sharing one), read off `reference`, Rugby League 26's overalls at that position (scripts/data/rugby-league-26.json), as many of each 2025 club's best as the season's clubs carry per club (`quota`), by linear interpolation; rounded and held to 1-99. Club shift: the season's results set each club's level, while its players keep their order. Each club's Simple Rating System, its regular season's margins adjusted for its opponents and a home edge by least squares, is ranked among the season's clubs (mid-rank percentiles) and read off `clubShift.reference`, the built-in 2025 NRL clubs' strengths: its target. Every player of the club moves by the one whole number (`shift`) that brings its matchday 17's strength closest to the target (of two as close, the smaller move), held to 1-99.
conversion.metric: core points a club game: NRL Fantasy's points for the eight NRL.com stats recorded in 1999 and 2000, the season before at half weight

reasons.tries: the try is what the game is played for: NRL Fantasy's biggest award
reasons.tryAssists: the last pass or kick before a try
reasons.lineBreaks: a run through the defensive line, the best gain short of a try
reasons.lineBreakAssists: the pass that puts a runner through the line
reasons.tacklesMade: a point a tackle: defence is half the game, and most of the middle forwards' work
reasons.missedTackles: a missed tackle lets the attack through: twice a tackle's worth taken away
reasons.offloads: keeping the ball alive through the tackle
reasons.errors: a knock-on or other error hands the ball over
reasons.allRunMetres: a point every ten metres carried: the forwards' and outside backs' work
reasons.kickMetres: a point every thirty metres kicked: territory, the halves' and fullbacks' work

clubShift.note: Each club's `team`: its regular season's Simple Rating System (`srs`, points a game, home edge `homeEdge`), its target, its lineup's strength unshifted (`strength`) and shifted (`shifted`), and the shift.
